source: tools/build_blog.py from reports/usage.csv + reports/usage-gemini.csv (same numbers as the Behind the build post)

total.note: Logged runs only; mixed basis (list-price / API-equivalent / real spend), a size estimate, not an invoice.

basis.claude: Claude Code ran on a Claude subscription login, so this is a list-price equivalent, not a charge: est. $109.70 = $98.17 reported by the tool + $11.54 token-priced (logged tokens x list price). Includes two play-site design runs ($8.38) and the channel-art kit ($6.15). Not included: a killed pass with no token log (est. $7.15).
basis.codex: Codex ran on a ChatGPT plan login, so this is an API-equivalent, not a charge: est. $24.08 token-priced (recorded tokens x gpt-6.1-sol list price). Not included: iteration 7, whose tokens were not recorded (est. $0.80).
basis.deepseek: DeepSeek was pay-as-you-go, real API spend: est. $9.55 token-priced (measured tokens x list price). The account balance itself fell $8.92 by Oct 22 22:25 ET and $9.87 by Oct 23 14:09 ET, after the co-op and voice chat rounds; the gap includes a killed pass with no token log ($0.29 by the balance counter).
basis.gemini: Gemini 4 Argon ran through the Antigravity CLI: est. $67.46 = est. $53.55 billed to a paid Gemini API key (14 runs) + est. $13.91 on a Google login (its first 8 runs, until that login hit its usage limit). Measured tokens x Gemini 4 Argon list price.

note: cost_usd = every logged run of that harness (its usage log), including play-site design runs and the co-op and voice chat rounds (coop_voice_*); runs with no token log are listed as unlogged_est_usd and not added. The Assets v2 phase column is the logged build, polish and docs runs of the upgrade. Every figure is est.: list-price or API-equivalent for Claude and Codex, real spend for DeepSeek and for Gemini on its paid API key.
